# POSpire v1.1.4: Hotfix for bench migrate

A hotfix release on top of v1.1.3. Nothing changes for cashiers, and there is nothing to do after upgrading. If you are coming from v1.0.x, read **Upgrading from v1.0.x** in the v1.1.2 notes first.

## What was fixed

- **`bench migrate` failed after upgrading to v1.1.2 or v1.1.3.** The migration stopped at the end with `ImplicitCommitError` on `pospire_strict_closure_idx`. This hit sites that did not have that database index yet, which is most sites upgraded from v1.0.x and all fresh installs. The index is now created in a way that Frappe allows during migrate, so `bench migrate` completes.

## If your migrate already failed

Upgrade to v1.1.4 and run `bench migrate` again. It finishes the steps that were stopped. Nothing else is needed.
